That would contaminate every numeric consumer and falsely establish the tranche's prototype method.

The author-admission sequence, holdout authentication checks, independent-review checks, and benchmark evidence binding are not mechanically closed.

feature_and_tooling.finding: Captured-buffer TypeScript proof and exact package/tree closure are materially improved, and the public harness enforces Reflect.ownKeys, descriptors, prototype, source immutability, no-throw, diagnostic-mode preservation, composition witnesses, and hostile linear-size inputs. Blocking defects remain in exported-parser topology reachability, author provenance, review identity, hidden-corpus admission, and benchmark correctness/comparator/attempt integrity.

evidence: author-admission-validator.mjs:323-369 increments global call counters and applies only count/key tests; it never proves that those calls feed the sole export.

Three stdin assays were accepted for B, S, and D while each exported the same exact H whole-prefix regex grammar and placed the required any/all/string/dispatch calls only in unused const declarations.

Accepted adversarial digests were B 67a311b0df85d3836e29243550534df9517cdd7dbb20fa4b23ff01ff4c98e126, S 1f768248f466ff401f07949e995962aad3d7de9d84eec89999802f2973b843ff, and D bf32182b329c7645ae82c9abe8650e84c1e58012f4ba3a7fd865d59495501372.
defects.required_repair: Reject unused/dead declarations and prove each topology on the exported initializer's reachable construction AST. Bind a pre-author provenance graph and pairwise construction review; byte inequality alone is insufficient.

defects.summary: The four-seat admission command is independent of pre-author admission and its author receipts omit owner-required provenance fields.
evidence: author-admission-validator.mjs:651-697 never invokes verifyPreAuthorAdmission, accepts no sealed manifest digest, and consumes no ACCEPT boundary/root receipt.
author-admission-validator.mjs:672-677 checks only feature, generation, seat, topology label, source identity, author_id, independent, and peer_source_access.

ADDENDA-07 section 3 requires served model, input-manifest hash, isolated candidate-root hash, commands, close time, provenance, and isolated authoring; these are absent from the executable receipt contract.
defects.required_repair: Make four-seat admission consume an exact successful pre-author receipt or owner-sealed manifest digest and bind every author's full provenance/model/input/command/close receipt to that same admitted boundary.

defects.summary: Pre-author ACCEPT can be bootstrapped from content-free, non-independent review JSON.
evidence: author-admission-validator.mjs:548-567 checks only feature_id, generation, review_id, scope, verdict, and a root array of review hashes/lengths.
It does not require distinct reviewer identities, independence from authors/root, three-altitude findings, defect/evidence fields, commands, or subject closure.
A root JSON that merely repeats hashes for two trivial ACCEPT objects satisfies the executable shape; hash binding does not establish adversarial review.
defects.required_repair: Define and executable-check exact boundary-review and root schemas with pairwise-distinct identities, independence attestations, the common three-altitude/all-axis rubric, evidence, and subject/precursor hashes.

defects.summary: The current holdout bytes are internally consistent, but the admission validator authenticates only canonical base64 and a few receipt fields, not the committed corpus envelope and precursor closure.
evidence: Independent checks reproduced precursor closure 67bb0e1af5f425d1dfdb56db792d7e2b4576182655f0b88da076a1d2edd75682, decoded length 82887, and magic VPI5CN1 NUL for the exact current ciphertext.

author-admission-validator.mjs:570-584 does not verify receipt status/corpus_id, the 14 exact precursor rows and closure digest, plaintext hash/length, envelope decoded length/magic, encryption/AAD declaration, coverage/anti-duplication metadata, or candidate/key/plaintext absence assertions.
Consequently, a resealed manifest can admit arbitrary canonical base64 plus a minimal matching receipt without this gate detecting that it is not the promised fresh hostile corpus.
defects.required_repair: Executable-check every public holdout-receipt field that can be checked pre-reveal, including exact precursor closure, envelope framing, commitment fields, coverage/anti-duplication shape, and absence/freshness receipts.

defects.summary: The benchmark times an arbitrary bundle and accepts cross-seat agreement as its only semantic preflight.
evidence: benchmark-runner.mjs:79-95 checks only three bundle exports and four parser-like values; it does not bind bundled parsers to the four admitted source hashes or their compiled artifacts.

benchmark-runner.mjs:58-76 accepts a corpus containing only id/source/offset, and lines 272-277 accept equal observation digests without any expected semantic oracle or public/revealed-holdout receipt.
A bundle may therefore map all four seat names to one identical fast parser, or four identically wrong parsers, and receive timing evidence unrelated to the reviewed candidates.
defects.required_repair: Seal a run manifest that binds admitted source hashes, exact reproducible bundle construction, public and revealed-holdout semantic PASS receipts, expected corpus observations, operation identity, and the captured bundle before timing.

defects.summary: The sole declared timing procedure cannot close the owner-required peer wins and cannot prevent retry erasure or forged receipt statistics.
evidence: benchmark-runner.mjs:9 and its schema time only H/B/S/D; no LIVE regex comparator or retained prior parse-that iteration appears, while ADDENDA-07 sections 5-6 require strict wins over every genuinely comparable retained peer.
author-admission-protocol.json deferred_acceptance requires only a four-seat benchmark receipt, so the omitted peer matrix is not deferred through an executable requirement.

benchmark-runner.mjs:256-341 emits JSON to stdout and keeps no append-only raw path or attempt registry; its claim that attempt_id is retired is unenforced and a failed or losing run can be discarded and rerun.

The runner merely parses its JSON Schema and never validates or independently recomputes a receipt. The schema permits any three candidate-name keys in pair_geometric_mean_ratio rather than the exact three peers and does not enforce logical consistency among samples, statistics, and winner.
Allocation is declared non-adjudicative without an UNAVAILABLE tool reason, despite candidate-specific intermediate allocation being a material distinction for this row.
defects.required_repair: Add the exact comparable LIVE/prior peers, immutable append-only attempt/raw-result handling, a recomputing receipt validator, exact peer-key/logical constraints, and allocation evidence or a concrete tool-unavailable receipt.

commands.command: three independent --assay-stdin B/S/D dead-topology adversarial constructions

positive_findings: The consuming operation is a semantic primitive under value-unit, not a scanner, atom, token object, component-value, or CST runtime.
The exact current public result boundary rejects prototype, descriptor, symbol, accessor, and surplus-key drift.
Compiler SourceFiles are constructed from captured buffers and every compiler input used by the type proof is checked against that capture.
The current public holdout receipt, precursor closure, canonical ciphertext, decoded envelope length, and magic agree without accessing plaintext or key.
The benchmark schedule is position and ordered-adjacency balanced and its O(1) observation fold avoids source slicing inside timing.
